Topic 8.2: Bracelet making ORNAMENTS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Bracelet making ORNAMENTS. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. make simple bracelets using locally available materials for creativity
2. appreciate own and others finished work. appreciate own and others work

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. make simple bracelets using locally available materials for creativity
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to make simple bracelets using locally available materials for creativity. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate own and others finished work. appreciate own and others work
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate own and others finished work. appreciate own and others work. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Bracelet making ORNAMENTS.
2. Explain Bracelet making ORNAMENTS to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: The learner attempts to explain with assistance work available materials finished work
4. Show that you can: make simple bracelets using locally available materials for creativity
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Bracelet making ORNAMENTS. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Bracelet making ORNAMENTS important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. The learner attempts to explain with assistance work available materials finished work

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. make simple bracelets using locally available materials for creativity
2. appreciate own and others finished work. appreciate own and others work
